PLAN: Final solve—use the measured cut response to put both C5 and C6-paraffin blends on specification, with extra C6 rectification to limit naphthene leakage and a slightly lower T boil-up to avoid the failed boil-up-9 case.
Root gives exact C5-/C6+ split (T=1556). At T=70/6/6, about 124 mol/s n-butane remained in TB; boil-up 9 failed, so use 8. At B=80/6/6, BT contained 89% paraffins with n-pentane and methylcyclopentane contamination; increase stages and reflux at fixed boil-up to sharpen that split. Qualifying TB and BT are worth roughly $567M and $1009M/yr.
